findings.finding: All TDD-anchor scenarios present and covered: reply_markup-in-body (with both callback_data and url buttons), null-reply_markup omits key, answerCallbackQuery POST to /answerCallbackQuery with callback_query_id+text, null-text omits key, 5xx best-effort does-not-throw (Decision 8), disconnected-bot no-HTTP (optional anchor). 8 pass, 2 pre-existing @Disabled (Task 7), 0 failures.

Tests assert on real wire behavior — RecordedRequest path + Jackson-parsed body — not mock-call verification. Correct test type (integration: real Mongo/RestClient/TokenEncryptor + MockWebServer). Independent via @BeforeEach drain+clean.

answerCallbackQuery_telegram5xx asserts drainRequests().isNotEmpty() rather than an exact count (4 = initial + MAX_RETRIES). Loose check is intentional to avoid coupling to the retry constant; exact attempt-count mechanics are already covered by TelegramSenderTest. The IT only needs to prove the best-effort swallow and that an attempt was made.
